text.en:
1448
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
of Toboso, Salamanca, and General Luna, all of the mu-
nicipality of Escalante, Province of Negros Occidental,
are hereby organized into an independent municipality
under the name Toboso with the seat of government at the
barrio of Toboso.
The municipality of Toboso as herein constituted shall
have the following boundaries:
Starting from the mouth cf Salamanca River, upstream following
the course of this river to its intersection with Tinobaga Creek;
thence following the course of this creek to B.B.M. No. 6; thence
running in a straight line to B.B.M. No. 5; thence following the
course of the Aglolomot Creek until it intersects latitude 10° 45';
thence in a straight east-to-west line which coincides with latitude
10° 45' to its intersection with the present Escalante-Sagay bound-
ary line; thence southwestward following the said Escalante-Sagay
boundary line to the point where it intersects the present Escalate-
Calatrava boundary line; thence southeastward following the Esca-
lante-Calatrava boundary line, then the Escalante-San Carlos bund-
ary line as shown in the boundary and index map of Escalate ca-
dastre, B.L. case No. 2, surveyed July, 1917, to October, 1918, by
survey party No. 19 of the Bureau of Lands, passing through
M.B.M. No. 2, to M.B.M. No. 1, on the shore of Tañon Strait.
The municipality of Escalante shall have its present ter-
ritory minus the territory comprised in the municipality of
The organization herein made shall take effect on July
1, 1948.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of May, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the second.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
EMILIO ABELLO
Executive Secretary
